goal: Allow external tools to inspect block and header data concurrently while Bitcoin Core is running
Eliminate the exclusive database locking that requires stopping the node for indexers
reviewability: Author is reworking parallel reader access in draft and has been inactive for 77 days
Needs rebase before review is worthwhile
agreement: Broad concept support for concurrent reader access and dropping LevelDB dependency (josibake, theuni, w0xlt)
Verified by differential fuzzing across 5000 CPU hours without issues (marcofleon)
Unaddressed objection: Windows directory sync is a no-op risking corruption on power loss (stickies-v)
Concern that readers could observe partial state if a writer crashes with an unapplied WAL (willcl-ark)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it enables external kernel consumers like indexers to read block data while the node is running
It eliminates the exclusive database locking that previously required shutting down the node

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it completely replaces the node storage and crash recovery mechanism for block indexes
Core validation invariants depend on the integrity of the new write-ahead log and migration logic
